name: Tuscan Village
title: Tuscan Village Window Cleaning, Villas, Condos | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Tuscan Village and the Villas, a 55 plus community near Lakeway Regional. Steady plans, gate access arranged, $10 per window outside.
intro: Tuscan Village is an active adult community of condos and villas near Lakeway Regional, where many owners want a dependable schedule. CleanzATX offers plans that put window cleaning on the calendar so you never have to think about it.

sections.h2: What Tuscan Village homes are like
paragraphs: Legend Communities built Tuscan Village for adults 55 and older. It holds several hundred condos and villas, from about 972 to 3,200 square feet, priced between $300K and $700K. Some sections are gated, and Tuscan Village HOA manages shared areas. It sits near Lakeway Regional, which makes it convenient for daily needs.

Residents here often choose a lock and leave lifestyle. They travel, visit family and spend less time on exterior chores. Window cleaning fits that pattern as a service that happens on a schedule and needs little from the owner.

sections.h2: What Tuscan Village windows deal with
paragraphs: Villas often have patio doors, covered porches and tall front windows. Porch glass collects dust and spider webs quickly, since it sits under a roof and does not get rinsed by rain. Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April coat everything outdoors.

Sprinkler spray from shared landscaping hits the first row of windows and doors. Mineral spots dry white in the sun. Our water runs near 0 TDS, which leaves a clean finish without soap film, and removal of existing spots costs $10 per pane. Tracks and screens benefit from care at least once a year.

For gated sections, we arrange access with you or the HOA in advance. We follow parking and quiet hours and keep the visit short. Poles reach upper glass from the ground, so we do not set ladders on shared walkways. Inside work is done by hand with drop cloths, and we are careful in homes where owners prefer to be present. A recurring plan means the same crew returns on a predictable rhythm.

A 2,000 square foot villa is about $200 for exterior windows, which equals our minimum. A 972 square foot condo would still be the $200 minimum. A 3,000 square foot home is about $300. Twice a Year takes 10% off, and Quarterly takes 15%.

why: Plans put windows on a schedule, so owners never need to remember.
Gate and HOA access planned ahead, with short, quiet visits.
Porch and patio glass cleaned where rain never reaches.
Tyler is your direct contact for questions and changes.

faq.q: Can you work with a gated section?
faq.a: Yes. Share the code or the contact, and we arrange entry before the visit. We confirm timing by text.

faq.q: Do I have to be home?
faq.a: For exterior work, no. For interior work, we need access, and many owners prefer to be home. We follow whatever you choose.

faq.q: Is there a price difference for a condo?
faq.a: No. The same $10 per window applies, with a $200 minimum job. Many condos and smaller villas fall right at the minimum.

faq.q: How often do porch windows need cleaning?
faq.a: Covered porch glass can need cleaning more often since rain does not rinse it. Quarterly takes 15% off, with hard water removal on up to 5 windows each visit.

faq.q: What if something looks off after you leave?
faq.a: Text a photo inside 7 days and we come back at no charge if we are nearby. Satisfaction is guaranteed at 100% on every job.
